import json, re, os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib

# ── Parse all metrics ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
raw = open\('/tmp/all_paper_metrics.txt'\).read\(\)
blocks = re.findall\(r'###START:\(.+?\)###\\n\(.*?\)###END###', raw, re.DOTALL\)

data = {}
for path, content in blocks:
    m = re.search\(r'z_RUNS/paper/\(.+?\)/\(.+?\)/metrics\\.json', path\)
    if not m: continue
    dataset, model = m.group\(1\), m.group\(2\)
    try:
        j = json.loads\(content\)
    except:
        continue
    lp = j.get\('linear_probe', {}\).get\('val', {}\)
    knn = j.get\('knn', {}\).get\('val', {}\)
    cl  = j.get\('clustering', {}\).get\('val', {}\)
    sil = j.get\('silhouette', {}\)
    le  = j.get\('label_efficiency', {}\).get\('curves', {}\)
    data[\(dataset, model\)] = {
        'lp_bal':   lp.get\('top1_balanced_accuracy', float\('nan'\)\),
        'map':      lp.get\('mean_average_precision', float\('nan'\)\),
        'knn_bal':  knn.get\('top1_balanced_accuracy', float\('nan'\)\),
        'nmi':      cl.get\('nmi', float\('nan'\)\),
        'ari':      cl.get\('ari', float\('nan'\)\),
        'sil':      sil.get\('score', float\('nan'\)\),
        'n_classes': j.get\('n_classes', '?'\),
        'per_class_ap': lp.get\('per_class_ap', {}\),
        'le': le,
    }

datasets = ['CODEX_cHL_KRONOS18', 'CODEX_cHL', 'CODEX_DLBCL', 'IMC_NB_TumorSub', 'MIBI_TNBC']
models   = ['CIM', 'CIM_ProgFusion', 'EarlyFusion32', 'ResNet']
ds_labels = ['cHL\\nKRONOS18\\n\(18m\)', 'cHL\\n\(41m\)', 'DLBCL\\n\(40m\)', 'IMC_NB\\nTumorSub\\n\(31m\)', 'MIBI\\nTNBC\\n\(37m\)']
colors   = {'CIM': '#2166AC', 'CIM_ProgFusion': '#F4A736', 'EarlyFusion32': '#1A9641', 'ResNet': '#D6604D'}
markers_sym = {'CIM': 'o', 'CIM_ProgFusion': 's', 'EarlyFusion32': '^', 'ResNet': 'D'}

outdir = '/Users/simon.gutwein/src/MCA/docs/figures'
os.makedirs\(outdir, exist_ok=True\)

def get\(ds, m, key\):
    return data.get\(\(ds, m\), {}\).get\(key, float\('nan'\)\)

# ── Figure 1: Main metrics heatmap grid ───────────────────────────────────────
metrics_info = [
    \('lp_bal', 'LP Balanced Acc', True\),
    \('map',    'Mean AP',         True\),
    \('nmi',    'NMI',             True\),
    \('ari',    'ARI',             True\),
    \('sil',    'Silhouette',      None\),  # can be neg
    \('knn_bal','kNN Bal Acc',     True\),
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots\(2, 3, figsize=\(16, 9\)\)
axes = axes.flatten\(\)
for ax, \(key, title, pos_only\) in zip\(axes, metrics_info\):
    mat = np.array\([[get\(ds, m, key\) for ds in datasets] for m in models]\)
    vmin = 0 if pos_only else np.nanmin\(mat\)
    vmax = np.nanmax\(mat\)
    im = ax.imshow\(mat, aspect='auto', cmap='RdYlGn' if pos_only else 'RdYlGn',
                   vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax\)
    ax.set_xticks\(range\(len\(datasets\)\)\)
    ax.set_xticklabels\(['cHL\\nK18', 'cHL\\n41m', 'DLBCL', 'IMC\\nNB', 'MIBI\\nTNBC'], fontsize=8\)
    ax.set_yticks\(range\(len\(models\)\)\)
    ax.set_yticklabels\(models, fontsize=9\)
    ax.set_title\(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold'\)
    for i in range\(len\(models\)\):
        for j in range\(len\(datasets\)\):
            v = mat[i, j]
            if not np.isnan\(v\):
                ax.text\(j, i, f'{v:.3f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5,
                        color='white' if \(v - vmin\) / \(vmax - vmin + 1e-9\) > 0.65 else 'black'\)
    plt.colorbar\(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8\)

plt.suptitle\('MCA Paper Results — All Models × All Datasets', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=1.01\)
plt.tight_layout\(\)
plt.savefig\(f'{outdir}/fig1_metrics_heatmap.pdf', bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.savefig\(f'{outdir}/fig1_metrics_heatmap.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.close\(\)
print\("Saved fig1_metrics_heatmap"\)

plt.tight_layout\(\)
plt.savefig\(f'{outdir}/fig2_lp_bar.pdf', bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.savefig\(f'{outdir}/fig2_lp_bar.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.close\(\)
print\("Saved fig2_lp_bar"\)

# ── Figure 3: Clustering \(NMI/ARI\) grouped bars ───────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots\(1, 2, figsize=\(14, 5\)\)
for ax, \(key, ylabel\) in zip\(axes, [\('nmi', 'NMI'\), \('ari', 'ARI'\)]\):
    for i, m in enumerate\(models\):
        vals = [get\(ds, m, key\) for ds in datasets]

                      color=colors[m], alpha=0.9, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5\)
        for bar, v in zip\(bars, vals\):
            if not np.isnan\(v\):
                ax.text\(bar.get_x\(\) + bar.get_width\(\)/2, bar.get_height\(\) + 0.002,

    ax.legend\(fontsize=9\)
    ax.grid\(axis='y', alpha=0.3\)
plt.suptitle\('Unsupervised Clustering Quality', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold'\)
plt.tight_layout\(\)
plt.savefig\(f'{outdir}/fig3_clustering.pdf', bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.savefig\(f'{outdir}/fig3_clustering.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.close\(\)
print\("Saved fig3_clustering"\)

# ── Figure 4: Silhouette — grouped bars ───────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(13, 4.5\)\)
for i, m in enumerate\(models\):
    vals = [get\(ds, m, 'sil'\) for ds in datasets]
    bars = ax.bar\(x + \(i - 1.5\) * width, vals, width, label=m,
                  color=colors[m], alpha=0.9, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5\)

# ── Figure 7: Radar / spider chart — per-dataset model comparison ─────────────
metric_keys  = ['lp_bal', 'map', 'knn_bal', 'nmi', 'ari', 'sil']
metric_names = ['LP Bal Acc', 'MAP', 'kNN Bal', 'NMI', 'ARI', 'Silhouette']
N = len\(metric_keys\)
angles = [n / float\(N\) * 2 * np.pi for n in range\(N\)]
angles += angles[:1]

    vals_all = {k: [get\(ds, m, k\) for m in models] for k in metric_keys}
